text:
claire: Heads-up: trying to land an "autofallback inspection" feature in the console. Need to settle what "why" fields are required for audits.

ton y: spelling nit: it's autofallback (no space) but big +1.

jia: current backend exposes fallback_code only. For audits we need more: fallback_reason (string), policy_snapshot_ref, decision_id, a short signal summary (latency:1250ms OR error:502), and model_routing_hint.

omar: Also include request_route_id and org_id for scoping when exporting. We should avoid storing full prompt bodies by default.

claire: UX idea: small pill in the trace timeline: "Auto-fallback: latency" with a chevron to expand details. Expand shows policy_version and a link "view policy snapshot" plus a tiny evidence list.

ton y: product asked for human-readable reason and a machine-friendly enum for metrics. So both.

jia: For the API, propose endpoints: GET /admin/decisions/{decision_id} -> decision payload; GET /admin/decisions?org_id=..&from=..&to=.. for exports. Add header X-Audit-Access for RBAC.

omar: retention defaults: 90 days. Add org-level override to 365 for customers with active investigations, but require legal approval as a workflow.

claire: Security: redact PII and mask the first/last tokens of prompt if sampled. We'll include sampled_request_hash and sampling_rate in the payload.

infra-bot: Deploy notice: autofallback-audit-schema-v2 promoted to staging at 1723456830.

tony: One more: keep policy_snapshot_id in payload so UI can compute diff to current policy. Also include a tiny URL-safe signer to verify snapshot authenticity.

jia: We'll cap sampled_evidence at 8KB compressed. Also provide customer webhook opt-in for raw traces (with contract).

claire: Action items: @jia write admin endpoints + pagination; @omar retention/config; @tony work with product on language for UI; @claire mockups & copy.

tony: ETA: pagination + endpoints PR by end of sprint.

claire: Great. quick follow-up: how do we show when fallback was a "quiet degrade" vs forced failover? maybe badge color?

jia: add field degrade_mode: "quiet"|"failover"|"canary".

omar: noted. i'll update retention doc.

claire: thanks team!
remarks: short thread; infra deploy bot mentions
